Grain
Grain Programs and Solutions
The New Vision grain department's objective is to provide grain producers programs and solutions, grain transportation and grain handling facilities that will enable them to market their grain at price and basis levels which will maximize the profitability of their farming operation.
Current Grain Prices
Grain Policies
Make an Offer (opens in new tab)
Facilities
Seventeen grain elevators located in 15 communities.
Storage capacity of 28.6 million bushels.
Four shuttle train loading stations on the Union Pacific (UP) railroad and one shuttle train loading station on the BNSF. Also, one 75-car station on the UP.
Three feed manufacturing facilities located in Magnolia, Windom and Worthington.
Services and Programs
Individualized grain marketing plans and producer calls
Direct farm pick-up program
Market updates via text
Weekly newsletter
Quarterly producer marketing meetings
Monthly statements on status of specialty contracts
Internet access to producer grain transactions
Internet access to place cash, basis and HTA offers
ACH deposits on grain settlements
Open grain storage program and Grain Storage Certificate program
Fall Grain Policies
Extended Price Contracts
Free delay price program when available. (Winter, Spring, Summer delivery)
Direct Deposit Form
Individual Marketing
Planning & Solutions
New Vision has professional and experienced personnel on staff to provide marketing information and common-sense solutions, and to assist in developing customized marketing plans.
Innovative Marketing Contracts
New Vision’s goal is to assist producers in marketing their grain in the upper one third of the annual cash price range. This includes providing marketing contracts that enable producers furnace installers in my area to capture price premiums in the CBOT futures market. Also included is spread and basis information to maximize the final marketing results.
A wide variety of contract options are offered:
New Vision Cash Value contracts
New Vision Offer contracts
New Vision Basis contracts with 70% cash advance
New Vision Hedge to Arrive contracts
New Vision Conditional Offer contracts
New Vision Producer Accumulator contracts
New Vision Producer Accumulator with Euro Double Up contracts
New Vision Producer w/Euro DU KO and Guaranteed Quantity Accumulator contracts
New Vision Producer Laddered Accumulator contracts
New Vision Minimum Price contracts
New Vision Minimum Hedge contracts
New Vision Min/Max Price contracts
New Vision Managed Pool Marketing program
